capacity_usable_kwh.notes: ArenaEV Model S Long Range 2019: 95 kWh usable (EV Database search snippet: 95.0 for Apr 2019-Oct 2020 LR, 98.0 for Long Range Plus; not fetched, 429).

chemistry.notes: EVSpecifications 2017-2018 Model S/X: NCA (Panasonic NCR18650A, LiNiCoAlO2); Wikipedia Model S: NCA cathode.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Pack voltage 300-407 V (EVSpecifications: 302 V 75 kWh, 346 V 85/90 kWh, 400-407 V 100 kWh; ArenaEV 300-360 V), well below 800 V: 400 V class.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Tesla release note (software 2020.24.6, Electrek) for Model S/X: "when you navigate to a Supercharger, your car will condition its battery during the drive"; lineup-wide software feature. No manual control found; tesla.com manuals are blocked (403). Cars without navigation or on the oldest MCU1 hardware (2012-2017) may not run it: unconfirmed.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: InsideEVs: Raven Model S/X peaked at 200 kW at launch (2019), raised to 225 kW by software 2020.24.6 (Electrek, only recent cars) and 250 kW on cars ordered from July 2020. 2019 builds recorded at the launch value; owner may update.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: 2017-2018 Model S pages (EVSpecifications) give 11.5 kW and the 2023 Model S Plaid page gives 11.5 kW (240 V, 48 A); same charger carried over. EVSpecifications 2023/2025 Model S Plaid: AC 11.5 kW (240 V, 48 A). A 72 A / 16.5-17.3 kW charger was optional on some cars (EVSpecifications: 16.5 kW on Model X Plaid pages and 17.28 kW on the 2018 X P100D); standard figure recorded.
